name: devflow-plan
description: Whether a devflow plan's work items are ready to be made: each a vertical slice, with criteria a test can check and the items it waits on. Asked before the items are created; the state is the planned items (its `cards`), never the code.

vertical.instructions: Is every item a vertical slice: something that works end to end when it lands, rather than a layer or a step of another item?

criteria.true: each item's build ends in behaviour a person or a test can see
criteria.false: an item is only a layer (a schema, an endpoint with no caller) or half of another item

testable.instructions: Does every item have criteria a test can check, each one observable?

criteria.true: each item lists criteria, and each criterion names an input and what is seen
criteria.false: an item has no criteria, or one that no test could assert

dependencies.instructions: Are the dependencies stated and right: each item waits on the items it needs, and on no item it does not?
